nodes.label: DG32-LITE AI Compute Envelope (50 MHz RV32IM)
nodes.source_location: Thirty Use Cases, No Accelerator · Slide 03
nodes.author: DeepGrid Semi
nodes.rationale: 12.5 MMAC/s scalar budget and 16.5 KB SRAM footprint on a 50 MHz core runs 24 of 30 industrial ML tasks in <1.0 ms without a hardware NPU.

nodes.label: 8-Bin Goertzel Recurrence Filter
nodes.source_location: Thirty Use Cases, No Accelerator · Slide 06 & 09 (p. 11)
nodes.author: DeepGrid Semi
nodes.rationale: Evaluates induction motor slip sidebands (0.5 to 3 Hz separation) in 6,144 cycles (0.12 ms) within 16.5 KB SRAM, replacing 8 MB RAM required for a 2^20-point FFT.

nodes.label: Broken Rotor Bar Detection (MCSA)
nodes.source_location: Thirty Use Cases, No Accelerator · Slide 08 (Task 9)
nodes.author: DeepGrid Semi
nodes.rationale: Detects stator current sidebands fb = f1(1 ± 2s) sitting -40 to -60 dBc below the 50 Hz fundamental before mechanical failure destroys the stator.

nodes.label: Kurtosis Non-Monotonicity Trap & Dual Surveillance
nodes.source_location: Thirty Use Cases, No Accelerator · Slide 06
nodes.author: DeepGrid Semi
nodes.rationale: Kurtosis spikes on incipient spalls then collapses to Gaussian 3.0 on widespread flaking; dual-metric rule trends both kurtosis and monotonic RMS velocity.

nodes.label: CWRU Bearing Dataset Leakage Audit
nodes.source_location: Thirty Use Cases, No Accelerator · Appendix (p. 12)
nodes.author: DeepGrid Semi
nodes.rationale: 40 of 41 academic papers used leaky train/test splits inflating accuracy to 99%; true bearing-wise splits drop real accuracy to 65%–80%.

nodes.label: Tree Ensembles & 19-Model Execution Hierarchy
nodes.source_location: Thirty Use Cases, No Accelerator · Slide 04–05
nodes.author: DeepGrid Semi
nodes.rationale: Zero-multiply Random Forests (100 trees at depth 8) run in 0.06 ms (3,200 cycles) and 20 KB RAM, achieving 95.6% accuracy 50–500x cheaper than DNNs.

nodes.label: Hardware CORDIC Envelope Demodulation
nodes.source_location: Thirty Use Cases, No Accelerator · Slide 06
nodes.author: DeepGrid Semi
nodes.rationale: Reuses motor control CORDIC logic for Hilbert transform and envelope demodulation in 5,000 cycles (0.10 ms), outranking raw statistical moments by 4–5x.

nodes.label: AFE Sensing Constraints & ISO 13373-2 Dynamic Range
nodes.source_location: Thirty Use Cases, No Accelerator · Slide 09
nodes.author: DeepGrid Semi
nodes.rationale: The analog front end is the binding constraint: D = 6(N-1) dB yields only 42 dB on 8-bit converters, requiring 12–16 bit ADCs or analog notch filters.

nodes.label: Thirty Industrial Diagnostics & Observers Suite
nodes.source_location: Thirty Use Cases, No Accelerator · Slides 07–10
nodes.author: DeepGrid Semi
nodes.rationale: 30 native tasks spanning rotating machinery, electrical power, control motion, and sequence forecasting.

nodes.label: ASIL-D Advisory Decoupling for Machine Learning
nodes.source_location: Thirty Use Cases, No Accelerator · Slide 01 & Architecture Spec
nodes.author: DeepGrid Semi
nodes.rationale: All ML models run in an advisory telemetry role; hardware lockstep comparator retains autonomous 2-cycle (<40 ns) bridge shutdown authority.
